reason: This plugin is best classified as a file-management utility for DSH Web: it patches bundle configuration to force workspace directory selection through a browser-based browse picker, giving consistent local and remote behavior by avoiding host-native OS dialogs. Evidence from the README and manifest shows the core behavior centers on directory browsing/selection and folder creation via DSH’s browse host/UI picker integration.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于 DSH Web 的工作区目录选择场景，将目录选择固定为浏览器内的 browse 模式，以便在本地和反代/远程访问时使用一致的目录选择器。
summaries.en: This plugin for DSH Web sets workspace directory selection to an in-browser browse picker so local and remote/reverse-proxy access use a consistent folder selection flow.

capabilities: Browse host directories from the web workspace selector
Edit paths and navigate directory hierarchy in the browser picker
Create folders in the selected host directory during browsing

reasons.code: README describes replacing the default picker behavior so remote/local DSH Web sessions use the in-browser directory browse interaction for workspace selection instead of host-native dialogs.
README states the plugin composes host capabilities via browse services and invokes host.listDirectory and host.createDirectory RPC flows to list directories and create folders.
package.json declares a DSH bundle patch package and peer dependencies on the browse-host and browse-UI directory picker packages, indicating filesystem directory-picking integration.

capabilities: Browse host directories from the web workspace selector
Edit paths and navigate directory hierarchy in the browser picker
Create folders in the selected host directory during browsing
